# ORO MONETARIO ENTRE BCENTRAL-ACTIVO Y RM-PASIVO, MANDA DATO DE BCENTRAL
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #af1_31_6"))
sql_af1_31_6 = """
SELECT MONEDA, AÑO, TRIM,
       6 AS SECTOR,
       '31' AS C_CAGENTE,
       C_CUENTA,
       'H' AS C_ENTRADA,
       SUM(CASE WHEN SECTOR=6 AND C_CAGENTE='31' AND C_ENTRADA='H' AND C_SCN='AF.1' THEN DATO*-1 ELSE DATO END) AS DATO,
       C_SCN,
       N_SCN,
       'PS' AS FUENTE,
       '0037' AS PROC
INTO #af1_31_6
FROM TABLAS.dbo.BD_CTSI
WHERE (SECTOR=31 AND C_CAGENTE='6' AND C_ENTRADA='D' AND C_SCN='AF.1' AND FUENTE='CI')
   OR (SECTOR=6 AND C_CAGENTE='31' AND C_ENTRADA='H' AND C_SCN='AF.1' AND FUENTE='CI')
GROUP BY MONEDA, AÑO, TRIM, C_CUENTA, C_SCN, N_SCN
"""
work_conn.execute(text(sql_af1_31_6))
work_conn.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #af1_31_6_v1"))
sql_af1_31_6_v1 = """
SELECT MONEDA, AÑO, TRIM,
       SECTOR,
       C_CAGENTE,
       C_CUENTA,
       C_ENTRADA,
       DATO*-1 AS DATO,
       'AF.71' AS C_SCN,
       'Ajuste conciliación' AS N_SCN,
       FUENTE,
       '0038' AS PROC
INTO #af1_31_6_v1
FROM #af1_31_6
"""

sql_af31_6_sect = """
